sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct official model card
sources.evidence: Identifies the exact instruction-tuned release, Essential AI, dense architecture, 8.3B total parameters, tied embeddings, coding/STEM focus, tool use, open weights and Apache 2.0. Native context is 32K; optional 128K extrapolation requires configuration changes. Its later changelog labels the initial version December 8.

sources.title: Announcing Rnj-1: Building Instruments of Intelligence
sources.evidence: Dated December 5, 2025 and announces both Base and Instruct. Describes an 8B dense Transformer with global attention and YaRN, trained from scratch; discusses coding, mathematics, scientific problem solving and tools.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Gemma3ForCausalLM / gemma3_text; 32 full-attention layers, hidden size 4096, intermediate size 16384, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, vocabulary 128256, max_position_embeddings 32768, F32 and YaRN factor 4.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct complete checkpoint index
sources.evidence: Maps exactly 418 learned weight tensors to seven shards. Total tensor payload is 33,242,005,504 bytes. All indexed tensors were matched to bounded shard-header reads.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct tokenizer and chat template
sources.evidence: Accepts textual system/user/assistant messages and tool definitions; serializes function names and arguments in tool_call tags. No separate thinking mode or reasoning channel is defined.

sources.title: Rnj-1 Instruct Apache License
sources.evidence: Repository license text is Apache License Version 2.0.

sources.title: Official checkpoint commit history
sources.evidence: Repository creation is December 4, 2025 03:07 UTC; initial checkpoint upload is December 6, 2025 00:37 UTC, which is December 5 in the publisher's US Pacific time zone. Later changes affect documentation and the chat template.

sources.title: December 4 initial repository tree
sources.evidence: The initial December 4 commit contains only .gitattributes, with no model weights or model card; it does not establish model release.

sources.title: Initial checkpoint upload tree
sources.evidence: The December 6 00:37 UTC commit contains the model card, license, configuration, tokenizer, index and all seven weight shards.

sources.title: Later official Rnj-1.5 Instruct card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies Rnj-1.5 as a distinct follow-up to Rnj-1 Instruct, with changed local/global attention and a 160K context window. These newer specifications do not apply to the audited Rnj-1 Instruct.

name.note: Display name matches the exact rnj-1-instruct variant, distinct from Base and Rnj-1.5.

developer.note: Developer explicitly identifies itself in the release and model card.

family.note: Normalized family label for the named Rnj model family.

release_date.note: Use the explicit public announcement date. December 4 is an empty repository creation; the weight upload is December 6 UTC / December 5 Pacific. The current card's December 8 initial-version changelog is later than the announcement.

open_weights.note: Official weights are publicly accessible in seven complete safetensors shards.

license.note: Publisher licenses repository and weights under Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Complete learned count: 8,310,501,376 = 525,336,576 tied embedding/head + 6,442,450,944 MLP + 1,342,177,280 attention-projection + 536,576 normalization parameters. All 418 indexed F32 tensors are included; no duplicate lm_head, packed storage, quantization scales or buffers. Publisher rounds to 8.3B (family label 8B).

active_parameters_b.note: No separate per-token active count or accounting convention is reported for this dense model. Do not substitute the complete total.

architecture.note: Dense decoder Transformer, Gemma-3-like with global attention, grouped-query attention and YaRN; trained from scratch rather than a Gemma weight derivative.

context_window.note: Default trained/configured context. The optional 131072-token YaRN extrapolation requires edits and reports some regressions; the distinct Rnj-1.5 has a larger window.

modalities.note: Text causal language model and tokenizer; checkpoint includes no image/audio encoders or generation heads.

reasoning.note: Sources describe mathematical/scientific reasoning abilities but do not establish a dedicated reasoning/thinking capability flag. The ordinary chat template alone does not prove the baseline false assertion; clear it.

tool_call.note: Official documentation and template explicitly support function calls.

description.value: Open-weight 8.31B dense instruction-tuned model trained by Essential AI for code, mathematics, science and tool use.
description.note: Replaces nominal 8B wording with a rounded complete count and identifies the instruction-tuned dense checkpoint without benchmark superlatives.

patch.description: Open-weight 8.31B dense instruction-tuned model trained by Essential AI for code, mathematics, science and tool use.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint count is 8,310,501,376 learned parameters (publisher: 8.3B), with tied embeddings counted once. Active parameters are not separately disclosed. December 5 is the public announcement date; December 4 only created the repository. Context is 32,768 by default; optional 128K YaRN extrapolation requires configuration changes. No dedicated reasoning flag is established by primary evidence.

summary: Verified exact Instruct checkpoint and all 14 fields. Fill total with complete 8.310501376B learned parameters and architecture with dense; correct release from empty-repository creation on December 4 to the December 5 announcement. Clear unsupported reasoning=false. Keep active parameters undisclosed, confirm default 32768 context, text modalities, tools, open weights and Apache 2.0. Current model card and later Rnj-1.5 card were checked; the latter is a separate release.
